headline: Six Fronts Flare as Ownership Shifts Accelerate
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of base‑turnover has risen sharply in half a dozen theatres. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest sector, logging 62 ownership flips in the past day with colonial losses climbing to 8,901 and Warden losses to 14,800 while fresh enlistments reach 491. Fishermans Row follows with 45 flips, colonial dead up 473 and Warden dead 599, enlistments 261. Stlican Shelf records 38 flips, colonial casualties up 2,117 and Warden casualties up 2,414, enlistments 269. Callahans Passage holds at 29 flips but casualties surge — colonial +10,697, Warden +13,334 — and enlistments climb to 873. Mooring County steadies at 16 flips, colonial losses 6,537, Warden losses 7,111, enlistments 750. Nevish Line adds 11 flips, colonial casualties 5,239, Warden casualties 4,467, enlistments 541. All other regions report no ownership changes in the last 24 hours.
